requirement: Test imported-copy, linked-folder and read-only-source semantics without silent mode changes.
invariants: Imported-copy stages source bytes into one local VFS transaction, keeps mode='imported-copy', then detaches so later external edits cannot silently remain linked.
Read-only-source remains mode='read-only-source' and rejects privileged external writes with OC_STORAGE_READ_ONLY even if the backing handle can technically write.
Linked-folder remains mode='linked-folder' across granted, prompt and denied permission states; permission loss never silently converts it into imported-copy.
Linked-folder re-checks readwrite permission before every privileged external write and leaves local canonical recovery state unaffected when permission is unavailable.
Every linked privileged write requires an observed content revision; an external modification yields OC_STALE_GENERATION / external-change-detected before overwrite.
Conflict receipts retain compare, reload-external-version, save-opencontainer-version-as-copy and merge recovery choices.
Imported-copy and read-only-source only query read permission; write capability is not probed unless linked-folder needs privileged write authority.
